bio_am: Ծնած է Կ. Պոլիս՝ 1869-ին։ Գրող, մանկավարժ եւ Դաշնակցութեան ղեկավար դէմք, մահացած է 1951-ին։
bio_en: Levon Shant (Seghposian) was born in Constantinople in 1869, studied in Scutari and from 1884 at the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin, graduating in 1891, and then studied pedagogy in Germany until 1897. In the 1890s he published novels, stories and his collection 'Songs', and after moving to the Caucasus in 1900 for ten years he wrote the plays that made him one of the leading Armenian dramatists. A teacher of Vardges and Onnik Avetisian in Constantinople, he became a leading ARF figure and later, with Nikol Aghbalian, a founder of the Hamazkayin society and its seminary in Beirut. He died in 1951, still working on a pedagogical volume.
